overview: The sign editor open packet has an empty corpus: the sweep for S36PacketSignEditorOpen and PacketPlayOutSignEditorOpen returns zero hits across all 50 anticheats. The packet only flips GUI state, so anticheats police sign interaction on the commit side instead. NCP's AutoSign times the gap between the server granting edit rights and the C12PacketUpdateSign commit, and Intave's ItemCrashTracker.checkSign validates the returned sign lines; the open prompt itself carries no abuse signal and nothing in the corpus reads it.
